APP_HELP: USM video file demuxer and converter
HELP_INPUT: USM file(s) or directory(ies) containing USM files.
HELP_NO_CLEANUP: Do not delete decoded .ivf, .hca, and subtitle files when done.
HELP_VAPOURSYNTH: Use VapourSynth for video processing. Looks for matching .py scripts in vs/ directory.
HELP_HARD_SUB: Burn the default subtitle language into the video (re-encodes with x265). The output carries no soft subtitle tracks.
HELP_CRF: x265 CRF value when the video is re-encoded (--vapoursynth or --hard-sub).
HELP_PRESET: x265 preset when the video is re-encoded (--vapoursynth or --hard-sub).
HELP_X265_PARAMS: Custom x265 parameters (colon-separated). Replaces the built-in tuning.
HELP_JSON: Emit newline-delimited JSON events on stdout for a GUI/automation frontend.
HELP_PROBE: Read-only check what is available for each file (decryption key, local subtitles, VapourSynth script).
HELP_CRACK: Recover each file's decryption key from its own video stream and report it, without demuxing or converting.
HELP_UPDATE: Check GitHub for a newer release and update.
HELP_KEY: Manually supply the decryption key for a single file, as the decimal videoKey or, for a 7.1 file, audioKey:aesKey.
HELP_DEFAULT_AUDIO: Audio language to flag as default.
HELP_DEFAULT_SUB: Subtitle language code to flag as default.
HELP_FLAT: Write .mkv directly into the output directory without a parent folder.
HELP_VERSION: Display Charlotte's current version and exit.
UPDATE_WITH_OTHER_MODES: --update cannot be combined with input files or other modes.
KEY_WITH_MANY_FILES: --key is only valid with a single input file.
NOT_FILE_OR_DIRECTORY: Not a valid file or directory: {path}
KEYS_UPDATE_PROMPT: Some local keys are missing, but an updated key list is available. Update now?
KEY_NOT_VIDEO_KEY: {stem} uses the old encryption, so --key must be a decimal videoKey.
KEY_NOT_STREAM_KEYS: {stem} uses the 7.1 encryption, so --key must be audioKey:aesKey.
CRACK_STREAM_CIPHER: the video uses the 7.1 encryption that cannot be cracked
CRACK_NO_VIDEO: no IVF video stream in this file
CRACK_ONE_PAYLOAD: only one distinct video payload, so there is no second half to confirm it
CRACK_HALVES_DISAGREE: independent halves of the video disagree ({size} bytes sampled)
SUBTITLE_CHECK_FAILED: Failed to check for subtitle updates: {error}
SUBTITLE_ARCHIVE_INVALID: Archive is not a valid zip.
VS_CLIP_FAILED: Error building the VapourSynth clip for {stem}: {error}
FFMPEG_MISSING: FFmpeg not found. Place ffmpeg.exe in the root directory and try again.
UPDATE_NO_ZIP: The latest release has no .zip asset to download.
UPDATE_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to write the update to disk: {error}
UPDATE_NO_ENGINE: The update bundle has no charlotte-cli.exe inside.
UPDATE_ZIP_INVALID: The update bundle is not a valid zip: {error}
UPDATE_NOT_EXE: Downloaded file is not a valid Windows executable.
UPDATE_MOVE_ASIDE_FAILED: Failed to move the current binary aside: {error}
UPDATE_SWAP_FAILED: Failed to put the new binary in place: {error}
